content.title: About Australia
content.text: Australian Embassy Tokyo Japan Skip to main content Text size English 日本語 About Australia Australia in Brief DFAT's Australia in Brief publication provides an overview of Australia, including information on Australia's trade, economy, foreign relations, environment, government, Indigenous peoples, science, culture and more. Download "Australia in Brief" in word file and PDF file. Ministry list A current ministry list is available here. Resource in Japanese The Embassy provides various information about Australia. "Motto Shiritai! Australia (Tell Me About Australia)" is a website for Japanese students to learn about the general lifestyle, culture and history about Australia. https://tell-me-about-australia.jp/ Other resources The australia.gov.au website contains some useful resources for those who would like learn about Australia. Tourism Australia also provides information on Australia, including information on climate, time zones, currency and Australian animals.
